title: Production results and review
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Initial test results, Monday
Lot A: 200 units tested; 190 passed immediately; 8 sent for rework; 2 marked for scrap.
Lot B: 100 units tested; 96 passed immediately; 3 sent for rework; 1 marked for scrap.
For this report, first-pass yield means the number that passed immediately divided by the number tested, expressed as a percentage. Reworked units are not counted as first-pass successes.

Tuesday follow-up (same test report)
All eight reworked units from Lot A passed the repeat test. The two scrap units remain excluded from shipment. Lot B’s rework is still in progress.

DOCUMENT 2 — Manager’s note
Please compare first-pass performance, not only the final number accepted. Rework uses extra time even when it succeeds. Connector alignment was the most frequent reason for rework on Monday; the process team will check the fixture before changing the assembly instructions. The results do not yet establish that the fixture caused the problem.

文件一——星期一初測結果
A 批：測試 200 台；190 台立即通過；8 台送重工；2 台標為報廢。
B 批：測試 100 台；96 台立即通過；3 台送重工；1 台標為報廢。
本報告的一次通過率定義為立即通過數除以受測數，再換算百分比。重工品不計入首次通過數。

星期二追蹤更新（同一測試報告）
A 批八台重工品全部通過複測，兩台報廢品仍不得出貨。B 批重工仍在進行。

文件二——主管備註
請比較首次測試表現，不要只看最終合格數量。即使重工成功也會耗用額外時間。星期一最常見的重工原因是連接器對位不良；製程團隊會先檢查治具，再變更組裝指導書。目前結果尚不能證明治具就是問題原因。
